**Marcus Aurelius — Meditations VII.74**  
<sub>George Long translation · <a href="reading-233.md" aria-label="Previous reading">←</a> Reading 234 of 437 <a href="reading-235.md" aria-label="Next reading">→</a></sub>

> 74\. No man is tired of receiving what is useful\. But it is useful to act
> according to nature\. Do not then be tired of receiving what is useful by
> doing it to others\.
